news.title: BCCA: The Gods of Zul'Aman Now Live
news.summary: Journey into the eerie Ghostlands, just south of the once-beautiful elven kingdom of Quel'Thalas, and brave the Amani stronghold of Zul'Aman.

news.title: Claim Your World of Warcraft: Forever Character Names
news.summary: Get ready to make your mark in Azeroth! World of Warcraft: Forever Early Name reservations will be available from October 27 through November 3, offering an early opportunity to reserve names for up to three characters.

news.title: Explore the New Dungeons of World of Warcraft: Forever
news.summary: Explore nine new World of Warcraft: Forever dungeons across the Eastern Kingdoms and Kalimdor, with level ranges from 13 to 60. Venture beneath familiar cities, beyond sealed gates, and into long-unexplored corners of Azeroth.

news.title: Unlock a Year of World of Warcraft®
news.summary: Claim a 12-Month Subscription or 365-Days Game Time and get bonus in-game cosmetic items, including several for use in World of Warcraft: Forever!

news.title: Pre-Purchase World of Warcraft: Forever Upgrades
news.summary: Answer the call to a reimagined Azeroth with World of Warcraft: Forever. Pre-purchase the Skyborne Heroic Pack, Skyborne Epic Pack, or Warcraft Forever Collection on the Battle.net Shop to unlock upgrade benefits, prepare for beta, and bring a friend along with Invite-A-Friend Launch Codes when it goes live.

forever.launchLine: World of Warcraft: Forever launches on November 4, 2026.
forever.namesLine: Early Name Reservation will be available starting October 27 through November 3.
forever.collectionLine: Warcraft Forever Collection will be available through January 11, 2027.
forever.heroLine: World of Warcraft: Forever is coming November 4!

events.title: World of Warcraft Live Q&A
events.desc: Live Q&A with the WoW development team on BlizzCon 2026 reveals, 10:00 a.m. PDT on the official Warcraft Twitch and YouTube channels.
